headline: Red Sox return to Fenway riding high after a massive weekend sweep
morning_brew: We are finally back at Fenway tonight, and the vibe around the yard is as electric as I have seen it all summer. A five-game winning streak heading into this series against the White Sox is exactly the medicine we needed to keep the heat on in the AL East. Ceddanne Rafaela is playing like a man possessed, and if he keeps swinging that bat with this kind of authority, the rest of the league better watch out. I am trying my damndest not to start printing playoff tickets already, but this group finally feels like they know exactly who they are.

The front office did what they had to do at the deadline, and now the focus shifts back to the grass. It is about damn time we saw this kind of stability from both the rotation and the bullpen. I have been shouting about this lineup's ceiling since April, and watching them put it all together on the road against the Dodgers was a genuine treat. Sully told me yesterday that he thinks we are a lock for the division, but I told him to save the optimism for October and just enjoy the ride before I lose my mind from stress.

Elsewhere, the Patriots are putting in the work down in Foxborough, and the news about A.J. Brown practicing through a thumb injury is the kind of grit you love to see in training camp. It is nothing more than a next-season storyline, but the intensity is clearly ramping up as we get closer to the fall. For now, all eyes are on the Fens tonight as we look to keep the win streak alive and show the White Sox exactly what playing in the Hub is all about.
